rpm.meaning: Engine speed in revolutions per minute.
rpm.range: 0 up to the rev limiter (see rpm_max); no other fixed limit
rpm.notes: A whole number. With speed_kmh and gear it gives the gear ratio.

rpm_max.meaning: The current rev-limiter ceiling of the engine as the game reports it.
rpm_max.range: no fixed limit (a property of the car)
rpm_max.notes: Compare with the tuner setting limiter.

gear.notes: -1 = reverse, 0 = neutral, 1 and up = forward gears. This is the game's own value minus 1 (the game counts 0 = reverse, 1 = neutral, 2 = first gear).

steer.notes: -1 = full left, +1 = full right. steer_deg gives the angle in degrees.

steer_deg.meaning: Steering wheel angle in degrees from the centre position, signed.
steer_deg.range: no fixed limit; bounded by the steering lock of the car
steer_deg.notes: The sign is presumably the same as for steer (not verified).

acc_g.meaning: Acceleration of the car in g. Kunos documents the order [lateral, longitudinal, vertical].
acc_g.notes: A third-party study claims the order is [lateral, vertical, longitudinal]: this is NOT verified in the game. Compare with g_forces, whose order is documented, before relying on one axis.

g_forces.meaning: G-forces from the game's graphics data, in the order [lateral, longitudinal, vertical].
g_forces.notes: Lateral is positive to the right, longitudinal is positive under acceleration, vertical is positive up (Kunos). Whether acc_g and g_forces agree in sign and axis order is not verified.

angular_vel.meaning: Angular velocity of the car in the car's local frame, in the Kunos order [pitch, yaw, roll].
angular_vel.notes: The second value is the yaw rate (multiply by 180 / pi for deg/s). The sign convention is not verified.

pitch_deg.range: no fixed limit; small values in normal driving
pitch_deg.notes: Positive = nose up. Converted from radians.

roll_deg.range: no fixed limit; small values in normal driving
roll_deg.notes: Positive = right side down. Converted from radians.

heading_deg.meaning: Heading of the car relative to world north.
heading_deg.range: an angle; the exact range is not documented
heading_deg.notes: Converted from radians. It wraps around, so take differences modulo 360 deg.

wheel_load.notes: The sum of the four values at rest is the weight of the car (divide by 9.81 for kg). A value near 0 means an unloaded wheel.

wheel_speed.notes: rpm * 2 pi / 60 divided by the wheel speed of a driven wheel gives the overall gear ratio, valid only with the clutch engaged and no wheelspin or locked wheel.

slip_ratio.range: -1 and up; no fixed upper limit
slip_ratio.notes: Negative under braking, positive with wheelspin, -1 = locked wheel (seen in the game).

slip_angle_deg.meaning: Lateral slip angle of each tyre.
slip_angle_deg.notes: Converted from radians. The sign convention is not documented.

camber_deg.notes: Converted from radians. A third-party study reports that the right-side wheels may have the opposite sign to the setup value (not verified), so compare left and right values before judging.

susp_travel.notes: The sign can vary by car (not verified). Compare changes of the value rather than its absolute level.

ride_height.meaning: Ride height of the car as two values [front, rear].
ride_height.notes: Some cars may report millimetres instead of metres (not verified): a value near 100 instead of 0.1 would mean millimetres.

tyre_pressure_psi.notes: The live value can change with tyre temperature, so it need not equal the tuner pressure setting.

tyre_temp_core.meaning: Average carcass (core) temperature of each tyre.

tyre_temp_in.meaning: Temperature of the inner tread of each tyre.
tyre_temp_in.notes: Compare tyre_temp_in, tyre_temp_mid and tyre_temp_out for hints about camber and toe.

tyre_temp_mid.meaning: Temperature of the middle tread of each tyre.

tyre_temp_out.meaning: Temperature of the outer tread of each tyre.

brake_temp.meaning: Temperature of the brake disc of each wheel.

brake_torque.notes: 0 at rest and without braking: read it under braking.

brake_bias.meaning: Share of the brake force that goes to the front axle.
brake_bias.notes: 0.56 = 56 % front. The tuner brake bias settings are in percent.

boost.notes: Kunos calls it an absolute pressure; whether an idle reading is near 0 or near 1 is not verified.

boost_max.meaning: The game's maximum boost of the car.
boost_max.notes: Not reliable: 0 on some turbo cars and an odd value on a supercharged car. Do not use it as proof of a setting.

bhp.meaning: Engine power at this moment, as the game computes it.
bhp.notes: A whole number. Not measured at the wheels: it is the game's own calculation at the current rpm and throttle.

torque.meaning: Engine torque at this moment, as the game computes it.
torque.notes: Not measured at the wheels: it is the game's own calculation at the current rpm and throttle.

fuel_max_l.range: no fixed limit (a property of the car)

max_gears.meaning: Number of forward gears of the car.

tc_level.meaning: Traction control level the driver has selected.
tc_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
tc_level.notes: 0 = off for most cars, higher = stronger. The game may report 0 for a system the car does not have, so 0 can also mean not fitted.

tc_cut_level.meaning: Aggressiveness level of the traction control throttle cut.
tc_cut_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
tc_cut_level.notes: The game may report 0 for a system the car does not have.

abs_level.meaning: ABS level the driver has selected.
abs_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
abs_level.notes: 0 = off for most cars, higher = stronger. The game may report 0 for a system the car does not have.

esc_level.meaning: Electronic stability control level the driver has selected.
esc_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
esc_level.notes: 0 = off for most cars, higher = stronger. The game may report 0 for a system the car does not have.

ebb_level.meaning: Level of the in-car electronic brake-balance adjustment.
ebb_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
ebb_level.notes: The game may report 0 for a car without this adjustment.

engine_map.notes: The raw level counts from 0; the game's HUD counts from 1.

diff_power_level.meaning: Differential lock level under power the driver has selected.
diff_power_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
diff_power_level.notes: A level, not the lock value: see diff_power_pct. The game may report 0 for a car without this adjustment.

diff_coast_level.meaning: Differential lock level on lift-off (coast) the driver has selected.
diff_coast_level.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
diff_coast_level.notes: A level, not the lock value: see diff_coast_pct. The game may report 0 for a car without this adjustment.

turbo_level.meaning: The game's boost target setting of the turbo (a float).
turbo_level.notes: Its exact meaning is not confirmed.

performance_mode.meaning: Index of the selected performance mode of the car.

performance_mode_name.meaning: Name of the selected performance mode, as text.
performance_mode_name.notes: May keep the name of the previous car on a car without performance modes.

diff_power_pct.meaning: Differential lock value under power from the setup, as a share.
diff_power_pct.notes: Compare with the tuner setting diff_power_default.

diff_coast_pct.meaning: Differential lock value on lift-off (coast) from the setup, as a share.
diff_coast_pct.notes: Compare with the tuner setting diff_coast_default.

damper_levels.meaning: Selected damper stiffness LEVEL as four values [front bump, front rebound, rear bump, rear rebound].
damper_levels.range: 0 and up; the limits of the car are in electronics_min and electronics_max
damper_levels.notes: A level (a click setting), not a damping value, so it is not comparable with the tuner damper settings. Cars without adjustable dampers may report 0.

tc_active.meaning: True when traction control intervenes in this frame.

abs_active.meaning: True when ABS intervenes in this frame.

esc_active.meaning: True when electronic stability control intervenes in this frame.

tc_in_action.meaning: 1 while traction control is cutting power now, else 0.
tc_in_action.notes: From the physics data; tc_active comes from the graphics data and need not agree frame by frame.

abs_in_action.meaning: 1 while ABS is modulating the brakes now, else 0.
abs_in_action.notes: From the physics data; abs_active comes from the graphics data and need not agree frame by frame.

engine_brake.meaning: Level index of the engine-braking setting.

tyre_compound_front.meaning: Name of the tyre compound fitted on the front axle, as text.
tyre_compound_front.notes: Shows which tyre the game really uses, for example a garage tyre.

tyre_compound_rear.meaning: Name of the tyre compound fitted on the rear axle, as text.
tyre_compound_rear.notes: Shows which tyre the game really uses, for example a garage tyre.

cg_height.meaning: Height of the centre of gravity above the ground.

ballast.meaning: Additional ballast carried by the car.

pad_life.meaning: Remaining life of the brake pad of each wheel.

disc_life.meaning: Remaining life of the brake disc of each wheel.

front_brake_compound.meaning: Identifier of the front brake pad compound (an integer).
front_brake_compound.notes: The meaning of the ids is not documented.

rear_brake_compound.meaning: Identifier of the rear brake pad compound (an integer).
rear_brake_compound.notes: The meaning of the ids is not documented.

electronics_min.meaning: Table with one entry per electronics field: the lowest value the car allows.
electronics_min.range: per field, see the field name
electronics_min.notes: Fields: tc_level, tc_cut_level, abs_level, esc_level, ebb_level, brake_bias, engine_map_level, turbo_level, ers_deployment_map, ers_recharge_map, is_ers_heat_charging_on, is_ers_overtake_mode_on, is_drs_open, diff_power_level, diff_coast_level, front_bump_damper_level, front_rebound_damper_level, rear_bump_damper_level, rear_rebound_damper_level, is_ignition_on, is_pitlimiter_on, active_performance_mode. Fields of systems the car does not have read 0.

electronics_max.meaning: Table with one entry per electronics field: the highest value the car allows.
electronics_max.range: per field, see the field name
electronics_max.notes: Same fields as electronics_min. Fields of systems the car does not have read 0.

electronics_modifiable.meaning: Table with one entry per electronics field: whether the driver can change that field in the session.
